flooded_area.source: Sentinel-1A C-SAR (ESA/Copernicus) cross-referenced with KSDMA 2018 flood mapping
flooded_area.method: Multi-temporal amplitude change with permanent waterbody exclusion and topological validity sanitization (EPSG:32643)

population_exposure.source: Census of India 2011 / WorldPop 2018 District aggregate model
population_exposure.method: Aggregate settlement density model: 386.57 km² × 1,480 pop/km² × 0.45 settlement coefficient = 257,456
population_exposure.uncertainty: First-order aggregate estimate; assumes 45% settlement coverage in rural/wetland terrain

roads_and_infrastructure.method: Geometric network intersection with flood footprint in UTM 43N
